summary: Executed /app/tests/test_idempotency.py and manual curl tests against public URL. All three idempotency scenarios pass: (1) unique key generates approval and stores in Mongo, (2) same key returns identical approval_id/trace_id/reply from cache without duplicate DB entry, (3) different key generates a new distinct approval and trace.
passed: POST /api/agent/chat with unique Idempotency-Key returns 200 with approval (APV-XXXX) and trace_id
Approval document persisted in MongoDB (approvals collection)
Duplicate request with SAME Idempotency-Key returns identical approval_id, trace_id, and reply (cached)
MongoDB has exactly 1 approval doc for repeated key (no duplicates)
Request with DIFFERENT Idempotency-Key generates distinct approval_id and trace_id
Public backend URL (https://idempotent-agent.preview.emergentagent.com/api/agent/chat) exhibits same idempotency behavior via curl
